question: Does the freely evolving doublet implementation retain independently seeded quadrature clock records with the same preparation and numerical controls?

method.action: Unchanged SS OCF 1; both complex doublet components; U=s-s^2+s^3, Z=1+.2s, V=.25-.4s+.2s^2, zeta=.1. Gravity decoupled.
method.units: c=hbar=m=1; time/length m^-1, scalar fields m; one signed period contains two invariant ticks.
method.domain: D=40; rho<24, |z|<48; h=.8 base and .4 spatial at fixed dt; wider 32/56 at fixed h/dt/buffer.
method.boundaries: Regular axis and mirror faces beyond a measured damping buffer; width4,strength.12; all damping sinks accounted.
method.initial_data: Exact nominal Test6 .900 profile bytes; independent weak clock quadratures, naive vs bounded residual-reduced rotating matter; isolated, matter quadrature, orthogonal doublet, compact neutral/structural +/- controls. Source variables all effective. No force after t=0. This separate control starts B at pi/2 relative clock phase; A starts at zero. The relative B phase is inapplicable to isolated A cases.
method.solver: Serial annular variational doublet NumPy RK4, dt=.02, time control .01; duration8; local samples .1; atomic hash-verified full-state restart.
method.tolerances: Engineering total E/Q error<.001; trace controls<.05; envelope and at least one simple-zero slope>=.1 initial; neutral sign error<1e-12; correction must lower actual residual. The weak-mode and full G0-G9 gates remain unqualified/not evaluated.

hypotheses.prediction: Action-derived forces, exact neutral sign/null, genuine local crossings, independent numerical controls and residual descent agree within locked limits.
A force/current/readout defect, uncontrolled embedding startup or nondecreasing preparation residual triggers a failed check without promoting physical survival.

controls.method: h=.4 while dt=.02 and all other pair parameters remain fixed.
dt=.01 on the .8 grid, same sample interval.
Widen both extents at fixed h/dt/sponge width and strength.

controls.method: Repeat the same 13-case matrix with B clock quadrature pi/2, using independent isolated-profile velocities. This is one extra phase control, not an all-phase guarantee.
